scope: processing-only platelet-derived products such as PRP-FD/PFC-FD
rules: Exclude processing-outsourcing products from the regenerative-medicine canonical facility/price/manufacturer system when they do not require a regenerative medicine provision-plan filing.
Do not count processing-only products in manufacturer share or cost rankings.
When encountered during audits, append a lead to data/processing_outsourcing_watchlist.tsv.
Record the processing contractor only when supported by primary evidence or a validated proprietary-brand mapping.
Facility may remain in the main database for separate in-scope treatments such as live PRP/ACP/APS; exclude only the processing-only product rows.
Validated contract-processing brands such as Waqoo PDF-FD/PDF-FD5 are excluded even when displayed on an in-scope facility price page.
